title: Cowboys tried to trade up to No. 9 during the first round

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys tried to trade up to No. 9 during the first round
sources.description: The Cowboys traded up one spot before taking safety Caleb Downs in the first round of this year's draft, but that deal only came after an attempt to move even higher was rebuffed.
